Package model

Class Request

java.lang.Object
model.Request
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Request extends Object implements Serializable
Request class to track formal applications sent by users to managers. It manages a simple workflow: PENDING -> SIGNED -> APPROVED, or it can be directly REJECTED. It records the exact creation date and time automatically when someone makes the object.
